title: AI Agent Development
description: Autonomous multi-step AI agents that reason, make decisions, and execute complex operations independently — without constant human intervention.
overview: An AI agent differs from a chatbot in one decisive way: it can act. Where a chatbot replies, an agent calls your CRM, updates the record and books the appointment. Velex Infotech builds agentic AI systems that autonomously plan, reason and execute multi-step tasks — gathering data, making decisions, calling APIs and completing work — inside guardrails and approval limits you control. We also build with agentic AI's simpler sibling, AI automation, when a fixed workflow is the better answer.

title: AI Receptionist
tagline: Every call answered, day or night
description: AI phone answering that books appointments, qualifies leads and handles enquiries in natural speech — 24/7, in English and Hindi.
overview: An AI receptionist is a voice agent that answers every inbound call, understands the caller in natural speech, and completes the task — booking, routing, or answering a question — without a human picking up. Unlike an IVR menu, it does not ask callers to press a number: it listens, responds conversationally, and escalates to a person only when the request needs judgement it does not have. Velex Infotech builds custom AI phone answering services and voice agents for clinics, law firms, property managers, restaurants and service businesses.

title: Data Analytics
description: Dashboards, pipelines and business intelligence that turn the data you already collect into the six numbers that actually drive decisions.
overview: Data analytics turns the numbers you already collect into decisions you can act on. Velex Infotech builds the whole chain — instrumentation, pipelines, a warehouse where it makes sense, and the dashboards your team actually opens.
